commits.message: feat: implement phase 2 data intelligence pipeline
fix(ingestion): collapse duplicate logical graph edges across evidence mechanisms

api.authentication: none (no auth endpoints exist; see findings)

analytics.approximation_policy: exact only within ANALYTICS_GRAPH_NODE_CAP; sampled otherwise, labeled approximate

mypy.result: Success: no issues found in 83 source files

alembic_check.detail: New upgrade operations detected: remove_index(ix_metric_results_case_id), remove_index(ix_metric_results_run_id)

quality_gates.environment_note: host .venv missing rapidfuzz/charset_normalizer; gates run via container (make test/lint/typecheck) or after pip install -e ".[dev]"

findings.title: metric_results single-column indexes drift between model and migration
findings.detail: Model (app/models/metric_result.py) declares only composite indexes ix_metric_results_case_metric and ix_metric_results_case_entity. Phase-3 migration a4b9c7e16d20 additionally creates ix_metric_results_case_id and ix_metric_results_run_id, so alembic check reports both as 'removed' and a future autogenerate would drop them. run_id is a live FK used to scope metric rows.
findings.recommendation: Declare the two single-column indexes in the model so model, migration, and DB converge and alembic check goes green.

findings.title: Root README.md is stale relative to Phase 3
findings.detail: README describes 'Phases 1 + 2', 'no analytics scoring', 'no frontend'; phase-3.md is marked Implemented and the running stack serves the analytics endpoints.
findings.recommendation: Update README feature matrix and quick-start (analytics endpoints, make seed, preview_analytics).

findings.title: No authentication endpoints; scheduled Phase 3 scope not delivered
findings.detail: phase-1.md notes auth endpoints as 'Phase 3'; Phase 3 shipped analytics. User/Role/UserRole/AuditLog models, bcrypt helpers, UserService, UserRepository exist but are unused. All endpoints incl. PATCH findings status are unauthenticated. phase-2.md lists auth as out of scope, so this is a documented deferral.
findings.recommendation: Make auth/RBAC an explicit roadmap item; app/api/dependencies.py is the natural injection point.

findings.title: Synchronous ingestion in the request path
findings.detail: POST /cases/{id}/ingest runs parse-extract-resolve-write-graph-sync inline; documented for single-worker local mode. Job status fields already exist for async execution.
findings.recommendation: Move ingestion to background execution / worker while preserving the job-status contract, then add a poll endpoint.

findings.title: N+1 alias reads when building the graph
findings.detail: EntityService.build_graph issues one alias query per entity; graph stats build the full in-memory graph. Fine at pilot scale.
findings.recommendation: Batch-fetch aliases per case in a single query.

findings.title: Empty placeholders and untracked artifacts
findings.detail: frontend/, ml/, infra/, data/ are empty. scripts/phase3_api_dump.sh and phase3_api_complete_dump.txt (625 KB) are untracked session artifacts.
findings.recommendation: Decide whether to commit a trimmed dump or delete.

findings.title: No CI configuration
findings.detail: No .github/workflows or equivalent; all quality gates run manually via Makefile.
findings.recommendation: Wire CI: lint + typecheck + unit always; API-contract tests with service creds; integration gated on Compose/service fixture.

findings.title: Approximation throttle in analytics
findings.detail: Exact centrality/communities only within ANALYTICS_GRAPH_NODE_CAP; larger cases use sampled math, labeled approximate. Intentional and documented.
findings.recommendation: Ensure consumers understand scores can be approximate at scale.

recommendations: Reconcile metric_results indexes (model vs migration); restore green alembic check (F-01).
Update README for Phase 3 and add explicit auth/RBAC roadmap item (F-02, F-03).
Add CI wiring for test/lint/typecheck gates (F-07).
Pre-fetch aliases per case to remove graph-build N+1 (F-05).
Move ingestion to background execution while preserving the job contract (F-04).
Reinstall dev deps into local venv so gates run without the container.
